name: guardian beast
mana cost: {3}{B}
types: creature beast
power toughness: 2/4
static: as long as CARDNAME is untapped, noncreature artifacts you control have indestructible, and other players can't gain control of them.
static: as long as CARDNAME is untapped, noncreature artifacts you control can't be enchanted. this effect doesn't remove auras already attached to those artifacts.
